response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT transreg, tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM matched) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares GROUP BY tradekind;
